The '''Jacipri''' were an ancient [[Species/Legends|species]] recognized for their temple of [[Deity/Legends|deities]] and their vast collection of legends and myths concerning the birth and [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
